'''The Desert Delight''' was a a variety of dish that was served at the [[Bantha Traxx]] restaurant, located on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. At this establishment it cost ten [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per dish.
